snippet.title: Gordy and the Monster Moon gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Gordy and the Monster Moon is a bite-sized, Halloween-themed Zelda-like in which you play a pumpkin astronaut going on spooky adventures.
Coming 9/29 to Steam and Itch. 
Wishlist on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/642020/Gordy_and_the_Monster_Moon/
